articles.title: MK Party challenges report linking Zuma’s health to possible KZN troop deployment
articles.description: The uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) Party in KwaZulu-Natal has condemned reports speculating about the possible death of its president, Jacob Zuma, warning that linking his health to a potential military deployment and unrest in the province could fuel public anxiety and political uncertainty.

articles.title: After the ICC sanctions, is South Africa ready for US technology sanctions?
articles.description: The ICC sanctions expose how dependence on foreign technology can become a sovereignty risk. South Africa should assess whether its public services could continue operating if access to major international providers were restricted.
